classes.name: BlinkIDLLexer
classes.description: A lexer class for Blink IDL that extends IDLLexer, overriding comment token handling and managing lexer table caching.

methods.name: t_COMMENT
methods.description: Method to ignore comment tokens in the lexer by counting newlines and not including the token in the token stream.

methods.description: Removes a specified token from the tokens list to exclude it from lexing.

methods.name: _RemoveTokens
methods.description: Removes multiple specified tokens from the tokens list.
